method: Built-in image_gen; original text prompts; files copied unchanged with native alpha. Reference gameplay was reviewed separately.

assets.name: profile-01-sprat
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production 2D SIDE-PROFILE fish character sprite for a mobile underwater eating/evolution game.
Art direction: polished 2.5D illustrated game creature, as in the actual gameplay of Fish Eat Fish.io: rounded sculpted 3D-looking volume, large clean painterly shadow planes, vivid aquatic colors, crisp subtly inked contours, smooth appealing materials and confident predatory personality. Not photographic skin, not dead fish realism, not a flat infant mascot. Entire ORIGINAL creature design.
Camera and composition: exact SIDE PROFILE, nose points RIGHT and tail LEFT. Only the camera-side eye is visible. No overhead/back view, no frontal portrait, no foreshortening. Single complete fish centered on a square canvas with actual transparent alpha. Fish occupies x=8%..94%, y=26%..74%, leaving clear transparent margins. Side fins are on the body, dorsal fin above, anal fin below, tail at the left.
Functional jaw anatomy is CRITICAL: draw a CLOSED mouth with an obvious thin lip seam running from the rear mouth corner at (x=72%, y=54% from TOP) to the front lip at (x=93%, y=47% from TOP). The seam is a straight/gently curved rising diagonal. Upper head and eye stay ABOVE this line, and the substantial chin/lower jaw stays BELOW it. Rear lower-jaw hinge exactly at x=72%, y=54%; chin bottom at x=81%, y=65%. No other body part may extend below that seam to the RIGHT of x=72% except the lower jaw itself. This allows the chin to be cut out and rotated at the mouth corner. Closed lips, no open cavity and no teeth protruding across the seam.
Eye: clearly expressive but moderate in size, centered near x=82%, y=39%; not an enormous baby eyeball. Snout right edge at x=94%. Gill cover around x=68%, body maximum bulk near x=51%, tail root x=25%. Clean readable silhouette at small size.
Constraints: one fish only, native transparent alpha, no shadow, no water, no scene, no bubbles, no text, no logo, no badge, no frame, no extra pose, no separated parts. Mouth shape must be anatomically part of the head, not a circular mouth sitting on its back.
Subject: A nimble small coral-orange tropical reef fish, subtle golden cheek and ivory belly, compact oval head and body, thin navy lip seam, moderate turquoise eye, teal-tipped pointed fins and a small orange forked tail. An energetic fish with clean sculpted form, not a smiling baby or a clownfish character.

assets.name: profile-abyss-backdrop
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide seamless background painting for a 2.5D SIDE VIEW underwater fish-eating mobile game. Match the actual gameplay language of Fish Eat Fish.io: deep blue teal water, large beautifully sculpted distant rock columns and ruins, soft painterly gradients, luminous turquoise ambient light, hazy layered cavern depth and a few muted pale sea plants along the far lower edges. The center 70 percent must remain quiet open blue swimming space. Not a top-down seabed, no aerial sand map, no realistic photographic reef. Rocks are side-view silhouettes receding in depth with subtle moss on their tops, not collision objects or foreground walls. Polished hand-painted 3D cartoon game environment, restrained detail, no childish faces. Wide landscape image, opaque, edge colors gently repeatable, no UI, no fish, no animals, no text, no logo, no interface.

assets.name: profile-reef
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent SIDE VIEW environment sprite for an underwater 2.5D mobile fish game. A small sculpted navy-blue sandstone shelf with a bright muted-jade mossy top, two elegant branches of pale coral and a few slender teal aquatic leaves. Soft painterly 3D shading, clean illustrated shapes, atmospheric cyan rim light, inspired by the actual side-view cavern scenery of Fish Eat Fish.io. NOT overhead rocks or realistic photograph. A horizontally arranged isolated complete outcrop centered on square transparent alpha canvas, all content within 75% of canvas, no base plate, no cast shadow, no fish, no eyes, no faces, no bubbles, no text or logos. Understated natural decoration below swimming characters.
